name: Initial Prep — Baseboard (Prime)
intent: Dust/wipe, fill fasteners, fill end grain, sand bare baseboard before prime coat. NO caulk in this phase — caulk does not bond to bare wood; main caulk_joints fires post-prime in MOD_PREP_BASEBOARD_PAINT.
doctrine: 1:1 mirror of MOD_PREP_TRIM_INITIAL with substrate-specific tasks for picture rail. Rate-matched to trim prime per extraction pattern.
